name: wf.sales.invoice
description: Cases 1, 3 and 4 of wf-orchestration-v1 (§5.2, §5.3, §5.4): one instance per conversation of IO.api.sales; sales, asked with a menu, hands an invoice to invoicing, whose due date fires a payment check by payments, consults the supervisors through IO.slack.supervisores, or hands the conversation to a person of the team there until it comes back.
